Nimble isolation regression probe

This local, offline test compares native scope, reversed nesting, and a static selector filter. It also checks the original Nimble runtime script against reduced fixtures. It is not a full Nimble visual regression test.

The tested runtime source is pinned to Nimble commit 214b5a8, file blob 072ef16f31477dbf2f336522c626d68ff43ef8aa. No network requests are made.

Open this file in the Safari version being investigated. JavaScript measures results here; the proposed selector-based styling does not require JavaScript in production.

Ready.

Interpretation: PASS means an expected observation was reproduced. Rows marked "known limitation" intentionally test for an existing defect; their passing does not mean the defect is acceptable.
